title: Ketogem Steak Tartare
description: A sweet, crisp, indulgent Japanese dish featuring a keto-friendly fillet of steak, grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Filet Mignon
ingredients.notes: Select a lean cut of beef

ingredients.name: Ketosis Seasoning Mix
ingredients.notes: A blend of sweeteners and herbs for flavor

instructions: Preheat grill to high heat (around 220°C or 425°F).
Season the filet mignon with Ketosis Seasoning Mix, salt, and pepper on both sides.
Gently place the seasoned steak on the preheated grill. Cook for approximately 1 minute per side until a golden crust forms, ensuring not to overcook.
Drizzle top with avocado oil during the last 30 seconds of grilling time to add an extra burst of flavor and crispiness.
Remove from heat and allow the steak tartare to rest under its own steam for about 1 minute.
Garnish with fresh chives before serving.
